## Requirements

framework-py needs Python 3.11 or later.

### With uv

```sh
uv add framework-py
```

> [!NOTE]
> The package name is `framework-py`, and you import it as `framework`.

> [!WARNING]
> Do not install it into the system Python.

Next, read [Data management](guide:data-management#saving-data), call [data_read](ref:data_read), compare with the [R package setup](r:guide:setup), or see [the requirements](#requirements).
